entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Barhi (Mahila) P. S. Case No. 16/2022,
registered under Sections 498A/ 494/ 506/ 120B/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 04/ 17 of the POCSO Act, Sections 09/ 10/ 11 of the P.C.M Act, pending in the Court of learned A.D.J.-III.,
Hazaribagh.
Petitioner happens to be husband of the informant from whom dowry was demanded and she was subjected to torture to enforce the demand.
Learned lawyer appearing for the petitioner submitted that the parties have settled their dispute.
Learned lawyer appearing for the informant has filed vakalatnama on her behalf and affirmed that both the parties are residing together and the dispute between them have been settled.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.D.J.-III., Hazaribagh in connection Ishwar Yadav vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
